# temps_access_vault (Resource)

A named group of `temps_access_service`s that sandboxes are given access to together. With `project_id` it belongs to that project, and Temps links it to the project's sandboxes.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_access_vault" "finance" {
  name        = "Finance"
  service_ids = [temps_access_service.billing_api.id]
}

# A vault that belongs to one project; Temps links it to the project's sandboxes.
resource "temps_access_vault" "web" {
  project_id  = temps_project.web.id
  name        = "Web"
  service_ids = [temps_access_service.web_search.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the vault.
- `service_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the access services in the vault.

### Optional

- `project_id` (Number) Project that owns it, created through the project's endpoint; unset for one of the whole instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.
- `version` (Number) Revision, raised by every change.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>
terraform import temps_access_vault.finance vault_0123456789abcdef
```
